messages:
rhea: heads-up — image scan flagged a KMS-wrapped blob embedded in an image layer pushed to our ECR registry: `registry.redwoodops/internal/onboard-agent:2026-03-21`. blob path inside image: /app/secrets/wrapped_blob.enc.

 diego: who pushed that image and which pipeline produced it? any chance this is an old test artifact?

 rhea: pushed by `ci-runner@partner-inc` via `partner-onboard-pipeline`. image manifest shows push time 2026-03-21T03:12:00Z. scanner metadata: `detector=kms-ciphertext, confidence=0.81`.

 anya: ok treat as suspected credential bleed. immediate actions: (1) quarantine the image tag (make immutable/read-only), (2) export ECR image pull logs and CloudTrail events, (3) check KMS decrypt audit for our CMK.

 sre-bot: [AUTO] rule=image-kms-blob-detected; recommended=quarantine+audit; incident=auto-created INC-2026-089

 rhea: quarantined tag by setting tag policy and created a copy of the image manifest in secure storage: `aws ecr batch-delete-image --repository-name internal/onboard-agent --image-ids imageTag=2026-03-21 --no-cli-pager` (note: deletion blocked pending ticket). checksum: sha256=0b7a... saved.

 diego: we need to know whether the wrapped blob uses our KMS key. can someone cat the wrapped header (redacted) or metadata from the layer?

 rhea: pasted header (redacted): `gcp_kms_v1|projects/redwood-ops/locations/global/keyRings/onboard/cryptoKeys/container-wrap|v1|meta:agent-backup`. looks like our CMK.

 anya: escalate: if it's our CMK, we must rotate and audit. plan: create new key version, disable decrypt permission on old version for partner principals, and run secure rewrap on quarantined artifacts. also ask partner to rotate any inner creds.

 sre-bot: [AUTO] checklist appended: export-ecr-logs, export-cloudtrail, create-key-version, disable-old-decrypt, quarantine-image, rewrap-in-secure, notify-partner, postmortem

 diego: i'm running CloudTrail filter for `Decrypt` calls on that key: `aws logs filter-log-events --log-group-name /aws/cloudtrail --filter-pattern 'Decrypt AND container-wrap'` will paste findings.

 rhea: ECR pull logs show two image pulls from partner CI runners in the last week. CloudTrail shows a Decrypt call from `serviceAccount:partner-runner@partners.iam.gserviceaccount.com` 4 days ago.

 anya: RBAC action: prepare a scoped IAM deny to prevent `ecr:BatchGetImage` for partner CI role against `arn:aws:ecr:us-west-2:123456789012:repository/internal/onboard-agent` for the 2026-03-21 tag. schedule a 2h window at 02:00 PT to minimize risk.

 ops: caution: denying access will break any active onboarding jobs. SRE says window will impact <5 active runs; they can reschedule.

 rhea: partner outreach draft: "We detected a KMS-wrapped blob inside an image layer you pushed that references a Redwood-managed KMS key. We have quarantined the image and initiated wrapping-key rotation. Please rotate any credentials referenced in that image and pause pipelines that may pull the 2026-03-21 tag." sending to partner-ops now.

 diego: action owners: rhea -> quarantine + checksum + ticket updates; anya -> KMS rekey + RBAC patch; ops -> SRE coordination for window; diego -> incident lead + postmortem. target: mitigations by EOD, rewrap sweep in secure env within 24h.

 rhea: saved artifacts and logs to INC-2026-089. will update as we finish rewrap. :thumbsup:
